proposed_boundary_controls.expected: CLI, direct Queries, existing HTTP and viewer publish the same selected physical contract rows/identities/filters; P1 call/import requests remain unchanged
For each of10 frozen byte/profile states: contract membership projection, all semantic facts/evidence and paged rows update=clean; restoration=baseline; do not renew stale source witnesses
Known missing witness key is selectable without fabricated file/definition/source handles; unreferenced renamed path does not alias old source
All12 baseline unknowns remain selectable with0targets; duplicate candidate membership never promotes a target; no recursive exact traversal from zero-target boundaries

Existing captured source handles inspect current accepted source/profile slices; fullfile SHA + physical UTF8 ranges; bounded redaction/truncation; no live source/Git/parser reads; no source jump for a missing path itself
Foreign/stale generation, digest, range or ID membership is refused; no excerpt inserted by viewer on mismatch
Changed source/profile/artifact, projection rules, service/protocol/namespace/certainty/relation/selector or expiry refuses continuation; held old snapshot never mixes new bytes

One budget across lookup/selection/traversal: depth2,50entities,100edges,10kwork,32KiB output,8KiB excerpt,.5s; all declaration evidence handles count with existing entity helper; explicit exhaustion/lower_bound/unknown and capped continuation
max_edges1 paged union covers exact frozen membership without skipped/duplicate physical occurrences; work/entity/bytes/deadline/cancel reductions cannot claim complete/unbounded results
Unenrolled/old P1 receipt remains usable for calls/imports; missing/foreign contract membership schema/index/enrollment refuses requested contracts and keeps viewer Contract choice unavailable

At most24 elements; stable append and replacement paging; keyboard/narrow-screen/source actions; saved typed filters/intents fenced by five identities+impact identity; no persisted raw responses/cursors
Duplicate/empty/wrongtyped/oversized service/protocol/namespace arrays, unsupported protocols and contract-only filters without selected contract relation refused
Only producer-captured exact Git base/current affinity can select same changed-path membership; deleted/renamed historical definitions not fabricated; commit/worktree byte equivalence unobserved

semantics.membership: Explicit profile dependency: origin declaration/binding/profile, referenced artifact/witnesses and profile-declared canonical endpoint candidates, regardless of present source affinity; not exact reachability; known missing witness keys never fabricate source handles or excerpts
semantics.reverse: Qualified target declaration to original producer/client occurrence only
semantics.service_filter: Origin service_id, not contract-owner or target service
semantics.unfrozen_mutation_reasons: Never inherit old baseline reason when bytes/identity change; grade only mutation-specific frozen reasons
semantics.unknown: Selected dependencies retain frozen zero-target boundaries and cannot expand exact reachability; physical captured origin evidence may be displayed, but no cross-service target or contract hop is invented; any upstream lexical traversal uses existing admitted call facts with possible-reachability wording
